problem_restatement: The active BTC robust-v3 short route has sparse forward evidence but no exact attributable V57 lifecycle. Portfolio-wide monitoring cannot by itself freeze the route's entry, venue protection, costs, exit attribution, excursion, and final net outcome.

prospective_boundary.selection_rule: Subtract the frozen cumulative readiness baseline and accept only exact attributed decisions at or after capture_start_ms.

minimum_diagnostic_evidence.short: At least one post-boundary attributable eligible robust-v3 short decision and fully resolved short lifecycle.
required_fields: entry signal identity and decision timestamp
margin, holding duration, exit attribution, excursion, giveback, and net PnL

validation_completed.identity_reconciliation: provider, signal strategy, symbol, short-only execution direction, run, profile, and fingerprint match the active checkpoint
validation_completed.baseline_reconciliation: 12 evaluations, zero eligible, zero open, and zero closed current-run lifecycles

failure_modes_and_falsifiers: Any frozen identity or short-only execution direction changes.
Readiness totals regress behind the baseline or a pre-boundary decision is admitted.
Generator or preregistration evidence changes before publication.
An eligible decision remains unattributed or a lifecycle lacks required technical or economic fields.
The watcher gains execution authority or implies profitability from one diagnostic lifecycle.
decision: Collect the first exact robust-v3 V57 short lifecycle without changing the live route.

confidence.route_edge: low pending exact V57 execution evidence
